digest.component_or_area: reconciler .bridge_state cache and tickets repository storage
propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache inflates the tickets branch to 1.04 GiB (92% bookkeeping, not ticket data) due to frequent edits to baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass fields that defeat git delta compression.

Deleting the timestamp field baseline_advanced_at and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to a separate .bridge_state/get_rotation.json file can reduce marginal packed cost per version from 12.79 KB to 1.74–3.2 KB.

A one-time git fast-export/filter/fast-import history rewrite can reclaim ~1 GiB of existing repository size while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with exact byte-identical HEAD tree re-add.

Rollout requires multi-step dependencies: deprecating baseline_advanced_at writes (A1), moving rotation bookkeeping (A2-1/A2-2), normalizing baseline fields (A3), narrowing prev_snapshot.json (A4), introducing store-epoch guards (A6-0a), and executing reclaim only after live workflow/host epoch-refusal proofs and operator quiescence confirmation.

Mixed-version read compatibility during A2-2 transition uses max(new, legacy) logic with self-healing scrub, gated by descendant workflow execution and explicit host runtime refresh rather than fixed delay.

Post-publish rollback requires operator-controlled ref restoration, re-cloning all writers to enforce epoch-mismatch fail-closed behavior, and verification of an off-repo backup bundle before re-enabling writes.
